name: co.chiefagenticofficer/cao
title: Chief Agentic Officer
description: Read-only access to published Chief Agentic Officer Perspectives and Playbooks.

tools.name: search_perspectives
tools.description: Search published Perspectives by keyword. Returns title, date, excerpt, and the canonical URL.

query.description: Keywords matched against title, excerpt, slug, tags, and body. Empty returns the newest.

tools.name: search_playbooks
tools.description: Search published Playbooks by keyword. Returns title, date, excerpt, and the canonical URL.

query.description: Keywords matched against title, excerpt, slug, category, tags, and body. Empty returns the newest.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get one published Perspective or Playbook by slug. Returns title, date, excerpt, body and category when present, and the canonical URL.

tools.name: get_playbook
tools.description: Get one published Playbook by slug. Returns title, category, date, excerpt, full body, and the canonical URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List categories of published Playbooks and how many Playbooks are in each.
